csv_project_name: AE & CM for San Ysidro Transit Center Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The San Diego Association of Governments may be seeking a consultant to provide architectural engineering and construction management services for the San Ysidro Transit Center Improvements. Conceptual planning refinements, development of a project study report, preliminary engineering (up to 30% design), data collection/technical studies, and preparation of environmental document for multimodal improvements to San Ysidro Transit Center. Improvements will include enhancements for pedestrian, bike, bus, and rail connectivity and operations. Included is an optional task for future phases of the San Ysidro Mobility Hub for planning, community visioning, and conceptual design to accommodate for additional services such as passenger rail.
